title: Files and formats: PNG metadata, MP4, WAV, safetensors
hook: Build a PNG that carries a workflow, a WAV file and an MP4-style box stream by hand, and see why a reader walks chunks and boxes, why a flipped bit is caught, and what dropping metadata really removes.

verified.claim: SaveImage uses PngInfo at compression level 4, and PreviewImage uses level 1.
SaveVideo uses movflags use_metadata_tags+faststart when writing to a path.
Audio is turned into floats by dividing by 2^15 or 2^31.
The PNG, WAV and box bytes come from running the lab, and every CRC is checked.
The PNG recipe in the browser lab produced a file that Pillow opened with the right size and both text keys.
verified.ref: a Node build of the page's function, read with Pillow

verified.claim: Chunk rules follow the PNG specification, and box rules follow the formats pages listed.

unchecked: What a browser does with a damaged PNG is up to the browser, and we didn't test several.
We did not re-encode files in real editors to see which keep the metadata. The docs say that some may drop it.
